jira_migration_api_pending: Project scanning will be available as soon as the migration service is ready.
jira_migration_attachment_accept: I understand these attachments will be left out
jira_migration_attachments_description: Unsupported or oversized files stay listed in the migration report.
jira_migration_cancelled_description: The migration stopped safely. Its snapshot is normally kept for 30 days.
jira_migration_choose_description: Choose the Jira site and project to capture in a fixed snapshot.
jira_migration_connect_description: Connect your Jira account to choose a project. ProjectProject only imports data your account can see.
jira_migration_connect_feature_archive: Keep the original Jira records and migration report with the new project.
jira_migration_connect_feature_control: Review people and mappings before anything is created.
jira_migration_connect_feature_snapshot: Capture one fixed snapshot so the source cannot shift during review.
jira_migration_connect_title: Bring your Jira project with you
jira_migration_connected_source_descript: This is the Jira site used for the fixed migration snapshot.
jira_migration_destination_description: Set the name, URL slug and ticket key for the new project. Jira issue numbers are preserved.
jira_migration_destination_invalid: Enter a valid project name, URL slug and ticket key.
jira_migration_discard_unavailable_descr: A file upload or cleanup may still be finishing. We’re keeping this import until it’s safe to discard.
jira_migration_error_generic: The Jira migration could not be updated. Try again.
jira_migration_failed_description: Nothing has been published. You can retry from the saved checkpoint or scan the source again.
jira_migration_failure_generic: The migration stopped with an unexpected error ({reason}).
jira_migration_failure_internal_error: The migration stopped on an unexpected error. Nothing was published; discard it and start again.
jira_migration_failure_preflight_blocked: Some mappings still need a decision before this project can be migrated.
jira_migration_failure_storage_unavailab: Organization storage was unreachable. Check the connection and try again.
jira_migration_item_pending_description: This migration cannot be loaded until the migration service is available. Its identifier has been preserved.
jira_migration_item_pending_title: Migration details are not available yet
jira_migration_mapping_required: Choose a destination for every row before continuing.
jira_migration_people_description: Link each Jira identity to a ProjectProject member, or explicitly leave it unlinked. Suggestions are not applied automatically.
jira_migration_planning_description: Name imported labels and components, then resolve only issues that belong to competing active or future sprints.
jira_migration_priorities_description: Translate Jira priorities into ProjectProject’s three priority levels.
jira_migration_project_empty: No Jira projects are visible on this site.
jira_migration_reconnect_description: Jira needs permission again before the migration can continue.
jira_migration_restricted_description: Restricted Jira content may contain information that is not visible to every destination member.
jira_migration_restricted_include: Include it and accept the disclosure
jira_migration_restricted_required: Choose whether to include or exclude restricted content.
jira_migration_resume_description: Return to a migration you started earlier.
jira_migration_save_conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving again.
jira_migration_save_timeout: Saving is taking too long. Try again before leaving this page.
jira_migration_review_description: Check the destination and exceptions. The project remains hidden until publication succeeds.
jira_migration_scan_progress_description: ProjectProject is capturing a fixed snapshot. You can leave this page and return later.
jira_migration_scan_queued_description: Your scan will start automatically. You can leave this page and return later.
jira_migration_selected_source_descripti: This is the Jira project captured in the fixed migration snapshot.
jira_migration_skipped_can_replace: Upload the downloaded file to this ticket. Update old Jira links in the ticket text if needed.
jira_migration_skipped_too_large: This file is empty or exceeds the 25 MB upload limit, so it cannot be uploaded to ProjectProject.
jira_migration_skipped_type_unavailable: This file type cannot be uploaded to ProjectProject.
jira_migration_site_empty: No Jira sites are available for this account.
jira_migration_snapshot_description: We found {issues} issues in {project}. Review this fixed snapshot before configuring the migration.
jira_migration_snapshot_fixed_note: This snapshot of {projectKey} on {site} will not change while you review the migration.
jira_migration_snapshot_gaps_description: Jira denied access to some data or it was unavailable. This snapshot may be incomplete.
jira_migration_snapshot_gaps_title: Some Jira data could not be scanned
jira_migration_snapshot_project_destinat: The destination project has not been created yet.
jira_migration_snapshot_visibility_descr: This snapshot only includes Jira data your connected account can see. Hidden or restricted content may be missing.
jira_migration_source_fixed_note: To migrate a different source, leave this job and start a separate migration.
jira_migration_status_create_done_warnin: This creates a nonterminal status. Choose the existing Done status to close imported tickets.
jira_migration_status_description: Map every Jira status to an existing ProjectProject status, or create a source-named destination. Only the existing Done status is terminal.
jira_migration_success_description: The destination is published and ready to use.
jira_migration_success_skipped: These files were not copied. Open each Jira issue to download the attachment.
jira_migration_type_description: Jira subtasks become ordinary tickets and keep their parent reference in the archive.
jira_migration_work_progress_description: The destination remains hidden until every record is validated and publication succeeds.
